binds.town: a town where people are falling sick

stages.journal: {giver} asks you to find out why the people of {town} are falling sick.
stages.canvas: A worried governor, short on sleep. The sickness is spreading through the poorer quarters and the town whispers of a poisoned well.
facts: People in the poor quarters of {town} are falling sick, with cramps and fever.
The town believes a well was poisoned.
The governor has had the wells checked and found nothing.

{giver}: Sickness spreads through the poor quarters of {town}. The town says a well was poisoned; you had them checked and found nothing.

stages.journal: Ask the notables of {town} what they know of the sickness.
stages.canvas: Merchants and artisans who would rather not be asked. Each knows a piece; none wants to say where the cheap grain came from.
facts: The sick are those who bought the cheap grain sold at the lower market.
The grain came in by night, from a merchant nobody names.
The gang leader of {town} knows who the merchant is.

locals_of:{town}: The sick are the ones who bought the cheap grain at the lower market this month.
The grain came in by night; you will not name who sold it, but the gang leader would know.

stages.journal: Ask the gang leader of {town} who sold the grain.
stages.canvas: The gang leader is amused that the lord's people need his help, and makes the player feel it. But he names the merchant, because sick customers are bad for business.
facts: The grain was rotten, bought for nothing and sold as sound.
A merchant who trades between towns sold it; the gang leader names him.

{gang_leader}: You know a travelling merchant sold rotten grain at the lower market as sound; you will name him to the player, for sick customers are bad for business.

stages.journal: Tell {giver} what made the people of {town} sick.
stages.canvas: Relief that it was not poison, anger at the greed. The governor orders the grain burned and the merchant barred from his markets.
facts: It was rotten grain sold as sound, not poison.
The governor has the grain burned and the merchant barred from {town}.

{giver}: The player found the cause: rotten grain sold as sound at the lower market of {town}, by a travelling merchant. Not poison.

reward.memory: The player found that the sickness in {town} came from rotten grain, not poison.
reward.town_memory: The sickness in the lower quarters was rotten grain sold as sound. The lord burned it.

failure.memory: I asked the player about the sickness in {town}; they never brought me an answer.
